newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says can't comment on discount rate -- Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says can't comment on discount rate -- Jiji.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency on Tuesday that he could not comment on Japan's official discount rate.
"I cannot make comments on the official discount rate. I cannot say anything officially on something which is wholly in the hands of the Bank of Japan," he was quoted as saying.
Hashimoto was being asked about media reports that a committee within the ruling Liberal Democratic Party planned to recommend an increase in the official discount rate.
An LDP official told Reuters on Tuesday the party had not yet decided whether to include such a request in a proposal to rationalise government-affiliated financial institutions.
